SEARCH-TRIMMED-CASE-INSENSITIVE/F1.why: Queries keep their surrounding spaces; e2e/search.spec.mjs's failed expect steps (Playwright reports the expect step) fail in all three runs.

SEARCH-TRIMMED-CASE-INSENSITIVE/F2.why: Title matching becomes case-sensitive; the search assertions fail in all three runs.

TAG-FILTER-AND-SEMANTICS/F1.why: Tags combine with OR instead of AND, so the tag test waits for a card count the page never shows: Playwright reports the test timedOut (15 s test timeout) in all three runs. Rule 3: a timed-out test is a timeout, never an assertion failure, and a timeout is not a kill.

TAG-FILTER-AND-SEMANTICS/F2.why: The partial e2e/tags.spec.mjs never combines a search with a tag: green 3/3. Control (filter.js unparseable: the page never renders, the test times out) red, so it reaches the module. The whole suite fails in all three runs, by assertion, in e2e/search.spec.mjs and e2e/sort.spec.mjs, which are not declared; no run had a load error or a timeout.
